method: Complete seven-page 0.5-second visual review of truth-harwood-2600-v058; complete six-page 480p 0.25-second reference review of 1574-1579 and 1612-1617. Assistant visual labels, not independently coach-verified.
definition: Visible live-ball field-goal attempts including blocked attempts; free throws excluded. Ordinary dead balls are reviewed negatives, not live playing time.
split: expansion frozen before predictions; same game as prior Harwood test, not a new-game holdout

shots.note: 黑衣突破至左篮近筐举球出手，球飞向篮筐；之后死球及罚球准备。
shots.evidence: truth-harwood-1612-reference-v058/timeline-01.jpg relative 1.75 and timeline-02.jpg relative 2.0 plus 1612; page 02 shows full ball flight to basket

reviewedNegatives.note: 前次运球失误后的边线恢复与白衣组织、传导，无出手。
白衣底线突破持球后将球传至篮下队友，再回传外侧，持球举起不构成投篮。480p序列显示连续接传球。
白衣外围传导被断；黑衣推进及长时间半场运球、传导，直到1613附近突破；没有更早独立出手。
死球裁判管理、换人和罚球站位准备，没有额外运动战出手。

reference.note: 480p annotation only; evaluation remains original 240p source. Visual alignment is not browser consistency evidence.

scopeNote: Consecutive portion of preregistered 1380-1680 range. Endpoint selected before review to complete minimum 60-minute dataset duration, not selected by algorithm results. Ordinary dead-ball time included; no advertisements or extended timeout. Earlier ambiguous ranges and remaining 1626-1680 preregistration retained.
